name: Huawei Ascend (chip) - Wikipedia, citing WSJ reporting on 910D
notes: No Huawei datasheet or product page exists for 910D; public evidence is press reporting plus patent filings describing a quad-chiplet part aimed at H100/H200 class. Third-party trackers circulate '192 GB HBM3 / 4,000 GB/s', but those pages cite Huawei's generic Ascend landing page, not a 910D datasheet, so the values are excluded here. memory_gb and bandwidth_gbps deliberately null.
